name: kine2go
summary: 将动物与四足动作捕捉重定向为 Unitree Go2 可执行参考轨迹并生成策略回放的数据集。
summaryEn: A dataset retargeting animal and quadruped motion capture into Unitree Go2 reference trajectories and policy rollouts.
scale: Retargeted clips, trained policies, rollout trajectories, and videos
scaleZh: 重定向片段、训练策略、回放轨迹和视频
license: BSD-3-Clause code; source dataset licenses apply
licenseZh: 代码采用 BSD-3-Clause；源数据适用各自许可
access: Dataset artifacts available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 数据产物已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 连接生物动作、机器人参考轨迹和仿真回放的完整资源
verdictEn: A complete resource connecting biological motion, robot references, and simulated rollouts
wmNote: 同时提供参考轨迹和策略回放，适合学习四足动力学。
wmNoteEn: Reference motions and policy rollouts together support learning quadruped dynamics.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2606.14433] Kine2Go: Kinematic dataset for the Unitree Go2 robot with diverse gaits and motions
evidence.statement: The dataset contains Go2-compatible kinematic trajectories with corresponding motor-level actions, collected from 40 policies.
